node_camp_hub.speaker: Troupe Member
node_camp_hub.text: Evening, traveler. The fire's warm and the wagons are quiet. What do you want to talk about?

choices.text: Ask about life on the road.

node_road_life.speaker: Sera
node_road_life.text: The road? It is long, dusty, and never the same twice. You learn to sleep through the creak of wheels and wake at the smell of rain.

node_wagons.speaker: Pip
node_wagons.text: These old wagons have seen more leagues than I have years. Every joint has a story, and every squeak is a promise that it still wants to roll.
